ios.desc:
Food with friends. Finally.

Copo is the home for food people - a place to share what you eat, discover new spots, and connect with others through food.

Explore what is happening around you, discover recipes from real people, and find tastemakers with great taste.

Discover food and people nearby
See what people around you are eating, cooking, and recommending. Find your next favorite spot.

Discover recipes from real people
Get inspired by what real people cook - simple, authentic, and worth trying.

Find tastemakers
Follow people with great taste and discover the places and meals they love.

Share your food life
Post what you eat, your favorite spots, and how you cook - from street food to homemade meals.

Join food experiences
See something you like? Join others and experience it together. Food is better when shared.

Cook together
From home kitchens to restaurants - connect, cook, and enjoy food with others.

Meet your food people
Make real connections through taste. Turn food into friendships.

Whether you are discovering recipes, exploring new places, or meeting others - Copo brings food and people together.

Download now and find your food people.

https://food.copo.st

quotes.text:
Solo/indie dev here.

Created ‘Shopify for Social Media’.

Create your own Tiktok/Instagram app, white-label, embedable. Your app, your brand, your domain, your icon, your rules…

For creators, communities and businesses.

https://app.copo.st
Https://virksocial.com

It is basically white-label Tiktok/Instagram native apps, but written all in web- including camera, native-like mobile feature/gestures/animations…

PWAs enable the same native full screen experience while bypassing appstore tax/rules.

For native apps, I have a React Native shell app that embeds a webview so I can create native Appstore/Googleplay binaries ready for publishing. With the new Expo CNG architecture, I can automatically create native apps binaries from console. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/copo-st/id6737266643?platform=iphone

You can embed apps/feeds/posts/profiles in web pages and native mobile apps(webview). So this creates a distributed social network on open web with various distribution/monetization/aggregation/commerce  models.

Exploring to make this user-owned platform/apps.
quotes.story_title: Shopify for Social – Create your own TikTok/Instagram app
